bull_bear.body:
- ~10.1% share of the Indian flexible bulk PLWPP bag market (FY2025); early mover in BOPP/PLWPP bags
- First in India and Asia to integrate laser-cut easy-open features into PLWPP pinch bottom bags
- Vertically integrated manufacturing (PP granule to finished bag) with in-house printing and 73,000+ cylinders for 1,950+ customers / 13,379 SKUs
- Highest EBITDA margin (18.1%-18.5%), RoE and RoCE among the selected direct peer group (FY2025)
- Export presence across 71 countries; Two Star Export House; multiple export-excellence awards
- Digitised operations (proprietary Knack Galaxy platform, SAP S4 HANA, MS Dynamics 365)
bull_bear.title: Bull — competitive strengths

bull_bear.body:
- Supplier concentration and PP granule price risk — Top-10 suppliers were 73%-86% of raw material purchases with no long-term contracts; PP granules are the key input
- Customer concentration — Largest supplier/customer concentration and reliance on top brands under B2B2C model
- Single-region manufacturing (Gujarat) — All manufacturing concentrated in Gujarat, exposing operations to regional disruption
- Export exposure (71 countries) — Export-led model exposed to trade policy, tariffs and FX volatility
- Raw material (PP) price volatility — Polypropylene prices are volatile and linked to crude oil
- Commissioned Technopak industry report — Market-share/industry data derive from a report exclusively commissioned and paid for by the company
- Working capital intensity — Inventory buffers of PP granules and receivables tie up working capital
bull_bear.title: Bear — key risks

business.body: Knack Packaging designs and manufactures customized, high-strength PLWPP woven bags and PLWPP pinch bottom bags (5kg-50kg) for food, pet food, agriculture, chemicals, building materials and other bulk applications, under a B2B2C model. It is vertically integrated from PP granule processing through tapes, fabric, printing, lamination to finished bags, and is the first company in India (and Asia) to integrate laser-cut easy-open features into PLWPP pinch bottom bags. It exports to 71 countries.
business.title: What they do

business.body:
- **Woven PP packaging:** Printed and Laminated Woven Polypropylene (PLWPP) bags, PLWPP Pinch Bottom bags (with laser-cut/easy-open), BOPP laminated PP woven bags, Block Bottom bags, Four Layer Metallized bags with windows, Shopping bags / bottom gusseted bags, HDPE/PP tapes, woven fabrics, woven bags
- **Add-on features:** Circular & back seam construction, half/full/register window, zig-zag cut, heatcut, bladecut, RFID/barcode/QR/NFC tagging, hot stamping
business.title: Products & brands

business.body:
- Knack Packaging SA (RF) Proprietary Limited — Subsidiary (South Africa, est. 2021): Imports and sells Knack products (HDPE/PP tapes, woven fabrics/bags, BOPP laminated PP woven bags)
- Sayem Knack S.A. de C.V. — Joint venture (with Sacos y Empaques Internacionales): Strategic expansion in Latin America and the USA
- Knack Packaging (FZC) SPC — Foreign entity: Under liquidation
- Knack Energy Private Limited / Knack International Private Limited / ADP Packaging Private Limited — Promoter group / related companies: Directorships held by promoters

History includes an additional Indrad, Gujarat facility (from 2020), rooftop solar (2022), a windmill (2023) and an 11 MW solar farm operationalized in FY2025.

outlook.body:

- Margin expansion: EBITDA margin 15.38% (FY24) -> 19.31% (FY25) -> 20.42% (FY26); EBITDA per kg Rs 33.14 -> Rs 45.15

verdict_pointers: Offer is a Fresh Issue of up to Rs 3,800 million plus an Offer for Sale of up to 3,500,000 Equity Shares wholly by promoters and promoter group (all Patel family); the Company receives no OFS proceeds.
19:1 bonus issue in May 2025 shortly before the IPO; promoter average cost of acquisition (adjusted for bonus) is Rs 2.86-Rs 7.50 per share.
Promoters hold 54.92% pre-Offer; extensive promoter-group/family shareholding (all selling shareholders are Patel family members).

concerns_observed: Supplier concentration with no long-term contracts: the largest supplier was 35.78% and the top-10 were 86.21% of raw material purchases in FY26, against volatile crude-linked PP granule prices.
Single-region manufacturing base entirely in Gujarat, on largely leased premises, exposing operations to regional disruption.
High export/US concentration: exports were 56.30% of FY26 revenue and the USA alone 23.66%, exposing the company to tariffs, FX and India-US relations.

Family-only Offer for Sale: all 3,500,000 OFS shares and the entire selling-shareholder set are Patel-family promoters/promoter group; a 19:1 bonus was issued weeks before the filing and promoter average cost is only Rs 2.86-Rs 7.50.

Execution and governance flags: auditor emphasis-of-matter, factual inaccuracies in corporate records/filings, a director/SMP unable to trace educational documents, promoter guarantees to third parties, and orders not yet placed for 100% of the new-plant machinery.
Deployment discretion: the Borisana capex (project cost cut from Rs 5,148.94M to Rs 3,649.56M) is not appraised by any bank, and general corporate purposes may absorb up to 25% of gross proceeds.
Contingent liabilities equal to 10.22% of net worth as at March 31, 2026.

red_flags: Supplier concentration: largest supplier 35.78% and top-10 86.21% of raw material purchases (FY26) with no long-term contracts.
Statutory auditor emphasis-of-matter in the Restated Consolidated Financial Information.
Factual inaccuracies disclosed in certain corporate records and corporate filings.

19:1 bonus issue shortly before the IPO and a family-only Offer for Sale (all Patel-family selling shareholders).
strengths_observed: Consistent growth with strong, expanding margins: revenue grew from Rs 6,545.6 million (FY24) to Rs 8,234.3 million (FY26); EBITDA margin expanded from 15.38% to 20.42% and PAT margin from 6.98% to 10.99%; EBITDA per kg rose from Rs 33.14 to Rs 45.15.

High and sustained returns with deleveraging: RoCE 45%-50%, RoE 36%-42%, RoNW 35%-41%, while Debt-Equity fell from 1.23 (FY24) to 0.62 (FY26); the DRHP claims the highest EBITDA margin, RoE and RoCE among its selected direct peer group and materially higher RoNW than listed peers (10.98%-14.34%).
Differentiated market position: ~10.1% share of the Indian flexible bulk PLWPP bag market (FY2025) and first in India/Asia with laser-cut easy-open PLWPP pinch bottom bags.
Vertical integration and scale: PP granule to finished bag, in-house printing with 73,000+ cylinders for 1,950+ customers and 13,379 SKUs, 43,300 MTPA capacity at 81.63% utilization.
Export-led franchise across 71 countries with marquee customers (Cargill, Baba Agro Food, Drools, Cristo S.A.), Two Star Export House status and multiple export-excellence awards.
Sustainability leadership: 80% renewable energy (rooftop solar, windmill, 11 MW solar farm) with quantified 2030 targets.
